name: gtts
title: gtts
description: Google Text-to-Speech (gTTS) for converting text to audio. Use when creating audiobooks, podcasts, or speech synthesis from text. Handles long text by chunking at sentence boundaries and concatenating audio segments with pydub.

related_skills.name: elevenlabs-tts
related_skills.reason: Both convert text into speech audio; choosing both TTS backends is redundant for the same output type.

related_skills.name: openai-tts
related_skills.reason: Both are TTS backends producing speech audio from text; using both is usually redundant.

related_skills.name: audiobook
related_skills.reason: gTTS is a narrower text-to-speech backend used within the broader audiobook workflow.

related_skills.name: TTS Audio Mastering
related_skills.reason: gTTS only synthesizes text to audio; text-to-speech skill also covers cleanup, normalization, alignment, and delivery.
